author: EmanueleCoradin
body:
#### PR description:

This PR allows PyTorchAlpaka inference to use the CMSSW device caching allocator optionally. Sharing the allocator between PyTorch and the CMSSW framework may improve memory reuse when multiple PyTorch models are run.

The implementation adds:

- A `PyTorchAlpakaService` to plug the CMSSW device caching allocator into PyTorch;
- A `PyTorchEDProducer` base class to implement inference and manage queue registration and cleanup. Without the service, `PyTorchEDProducer` continues to use PyTorchs default allocator.

The existing PyTorchAlpaka producers have been migrated to `PyTorchEDProducer`, and the `PyTorchAlpakaService` is enabled in the Phase-2 HLT and NGT scouting menus.

#### PR validation:

CUDA and ROCm test variants are added with `--useCMSSWAllocator` to exercise inference with the CMSSW caching allocator.

**NOTE**: I am planning to rebase this PR on top of #52012, so I am postponing some improvements like moving the `trow cms::Exception()` to cc files.
title: Use the CMSSW caching allocator for PyTorchAlpaka inference
